RE-STAMPED AFTER THE agromarin REBASE, NUMBER UNCHANGED. agromarin replayed onto origin on 2026-09-04, so every SHA in it changed and the stamps written earlier the same day were orphaned within the hour. Re-measured at c7964a30e in a clean detached worktree laid out beside a clean odoo worktree, as that lane lays it out, and it reads what the floor already said. This stamp names a agromarin commit, so an odoo rebase does not orphan it again.

PREVIOUS NOTE, kept because a floor that loses its history costs more than the stamp gains:

RE-STAMPED AT 5c9d04d76, AND THE ZERO WAS BRIEFLY NOT TRUE. This is a contract rather than debt -- the same standing naming_agromarin has, a gate kept at zero to keep a clean scope clean -- and re-measuring found it reading 6 while the ORPHANED-BASE flag meant the lane could not compare and say so. All six were user-facing Spanish UserError strings in telegram_bot_invoice_upload that never passed through gettext, so .pot extraction could not see them. Fixed in agromarin 5c9d04d76 rather than banked; this stamp records the contract restored, not a floor moved.

PREVIOUS NOTE, kept because a floor that loses its history costs more than the stamp gains:

7 -> 0. THE FLOOR WAS RED IN THE FALLING DIRECTION and carried no `measured_at`, so nothing could say when it stopped being true. Re-measured on a clean detached worktree at the stamped commit -- python odoo/tooling/lint/py_lint.py agromarin --count -- and it reads 0.

WHAT FELL CANNOT BE ATTRIBUTED, and that is the cost of the missing stamp rather than an omission here: with no commit recorded there is no tree to diff the finding set against. The baseline file was last written by 5b82c80a824 (2026-08-25); agromarin has moved since and nothing recorded where. This one reaches ZERO, so per section 9.2 the file stays -- driven to zero keeps its history, born at zero has none to keep. A sibling floor's stamp is the SIBLING's commit, recorded through `--update --root agromarin` from a clean detached worktree of that checkout, so it resolves in the repository that was actually measured.

PREVIOUS NOTE, kept because a floor that loses its history costs more than the stamp gains:

First baseline for this scope. `lint_case.is_core_path` scoped every test_lint gate to the community fork, so this repository's Python was checked by nothing at all; `tooling/lint/py_lint.py` runs the same checkers over any roots and its own CI now holds them here.

The floor lives in the community fork because that is where the gate and every other floor live, scoped by provenance so a run judges only this repository's count. `--mode no-increase`, as the other cross-repo ratchets: an exact floor across a repository boundary would make every fix here red until a matching commit in `odoo` banked it. Growth still fails, and lowering is done by hand from a workspace holding all four checkouts.

Measured 2026-08-25 with `py_lint.py <repo> --count`, under exactly the corpus rules the in-odoo gate applies -- verified by pointing the same tool at `odoo addons`, where it reports every number `ratchet.py --list` holds.
